notes: Hand-maintained. scrape.py writes every controlled parking zone that has no bays in the council's bay data to site/data/unmapped_zones.geojson, adding the details below so the map can show what the zone's traffic order says. Once the council adds a zone's bays, the scrape stops flagging it and its entry here can be deleted. Zones under 'skip' never have regular bays.

skip.B: Event-day permit area around the stadium, no regular bays

14.name: South Hollingdean
facts: Zone 14 permit holders only. Some on Hollingdean Terrace are loading only Mon–Sat 8am–5pm.

Pay, or park free with a Zone 14 permit. Max stay 4 hr, no return within 4 hr. On Davey Drive, Dudley Road, Hollingbury Crescent, Hollingbury Place, Hollingdean Terrace, Horton Road, Roedale Road, The Crossway and The Linkway.
Max stay 2 hr on Hollingbury Place (no return within 4 hr), 12 hr on Upper Hollingdean Road
